integrity: The extension witness, rank-order coloring argument, ordinal clique lower bound, and universality recursion were reconstructed directly. A finite hereditary-set replay checks the bookkeeping but is not used as evidence for the infinite quantifiers.
limitations: The proof is a short synthesis of standard membership-graph and coloring facts, so unindexed folklore priority remains possible. The extension-property argument is stated only for infinite regular cardinals; singular cardinals are not covered.
title: Coloring and universality threshold of hereditary-set membership graphs
